# Shopee Peek

> Tampermonkey userscript (one file, no build step, MIT) that lets logged-out visitors view Shopee Taiwan (shopee.tw) product pages and the first page of search results. When Shopee's APIs return the logged-out block code `90309999`, the script answers them with data from other public responses, so Shopee's own frontend renders the page, and it adds a BigGo reference price under the title.

Behaviour:

- Runs only on `https://shopee.tw/*`. Logged-in sessions get no data replaced, because Shopee doesn't send them the block code.
- Product data comes from the same product page fetched with the LINE in-app browser User-Agent; it carries the same structure as the `get_pc` API minus price, reviews, shop and shipping. Shop details are filled from `get_shop_base`.
- Prices come from BigGo, a third-party price-comparison site. They are reference prices, not live, and switch with the selected variant. Items BigGo hasn't indexed show 「查無價格」.
- Search results (up to 35 items, title and image, no price) come from BigGo (`tw_mall_shopeemall` and `tw_bid_shopee` interleaved), so searching does not hit Shopee's blocked social-preview route or spend Shopee IP quota. Shopee's frontend forbids pagination for logged-out users, so there is only page 1.
- When Shopee rate-limits the IP and the LINE fetch returns nothing, a full-screen card shows title, image and BigGo price instead.
- Never available logged out: units sold, ratings and reviews, shipping. Shopee removes them server-side.
- Side effects: sets the `language=zhHant` cookie if none exists; hides the homepage popup banner; hides and strips links/images from header clutter (keeping language, signup, login and account), searchbar hotwords and footer while short-circuiting their APIs and blocking external/subdomain clutter links (`x-dns-prefetch-control: off`); drops every in-page redirect to a URL containing `/verify/`, including captcha pages and when logged in; routes every XHR to `/api/` through `fetch`. Companion network filter rules live in `filters.txt`.
- Data requests go only to `shopee.tw` and `biggo.com.tw`. Requests made through Tampermonkey carry no cookies; the shop lookup (`get_shop_base`) runs inside the page with Shopee's own cookies. No analytics, no remote code.
- Tested on Brave, Ego Lite and Chrome + Tampermonkey. Chromium browsers need "Allow User Scripts" turned on for Tampermonkey in `chrome://extensions`.
